trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations are visible along the entire trailing edge; peaks are sharpest and most frequent on the distal third of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a consistent concave sweep from the median notch to the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected across the high-intensity fields of both lobes, with higher density on the right lobe.
